scope: Console observations and original-executable-backed interrupt-frame interpretation; no new compatibility claim or runtime fix.

original_frame_layout.method: Actual original caller prologues and saved continuations plus original SDK FPU push instructions; independent executable-backed replays passed. FPSCR is explicitly set to 0x00040000 before all 32 four-byte FPU saves.

common.vmu: Each approximately 20-second measurement contains 1,200 valid fast controller pairs, with no VMU storage operations or commits.
common.video_observation_limit: The terminal snapshot samples PVR timing registers and INTEVT. It does not sample framebuffer read-enable or establish decoded-frame publication.
common.fault_observation_limit: This is an intentional PROFILE stop. The interpreted SPC is an interrupted instruction, not automatically an exception fault PC; INTEVT is a last-event latch and EXPEVT was not captured.

rayman2.observed: Ubisoft logo visible at the beginning; controller and terminal diagnostic report remain responsive.

interrupted_context.glyph_verification: Ambiguous B/8 characters in SPC and R10 were enlarged and compared with known same-row font glyphs; the source call literal independently matches R10.

rayman2.finding: The sampled original instruction would store through an invalid, unaligned destination. This is the first iteration of the resource descriptor pass before the logo timed-delay loop.

resource.name: DCDATA/FIX.DAT
resource.allocation_policy: Original allocator takes allocations from the high end of a free span.
resource.source_review: The file is read directly into its rounded allocation and immediately supplies pointer fields at offsets 0x18 and 0x1c; the descriptor pass follows field 0xa4. No relocation was observed on the reviewed path.
resource.separate_logo_asset: DCDATA/VIGNET/ubisoft.img is distinct from the invalid resource descriptor table.

rayman2.hypothesis: The 384 KiB upper-heap reservation may shift original top-down allocation addresses while prelinked resource pointers retain their original addresses. FIX.DAT bytes and its live root were not captured, so this is not established.
not_established: The origin of the invalid destination
Actual FIX.DAT pointer encoding and allocation base
New-reader data corruption or a demonstrated cache-coherence defect
rayman2.legacy_control_owner_result: Current C29 Legacy (Y) also stops at the Ubisoft logo.

lodoss.owner_observation: No game video output; audible audio stutters and the game appears to continue doing work.

interrupted_context.stack_limit: The original SDK may switch to a dedicated IRQ stack; memory above its saved frame is not automatically the active game caller stack.

lodoss.finding: At the single sampled instant, game code was entering a MPEG program-stream parser. Downstream code explicitly classifies MPEG pack, system, end and packet start codes. This is not evidence that the parser itself is stuck or its input is valid.
lodoss.stream_error_limit: These are low SCI overrun results, not read-ahead guard failures. Existing retry/fallback handling may recover them. Zero CRC/read-ahead failures does not mean zero stream retry events, and the relationship to absent video remains unproved.
lodoss.next_observation_if_needed: Repeated original-PC observations and a bounded input prefix plus parser cursor/object state would test data and parser progress.

checks: An unrecoverable overrun returns before ready/arrived/position publication.
Failure leaves the request cursor unchanged; refetch uses the same block. Two consecutive failures select PIO; excessive failures terminate the request.
New data must pass CRC before delivery. Completion uses fully consumed sectors and requires the requested count without an error.
recovery_source_review.unobserved_state: The separate unrepaired latch can disable further CRC reconstruction after two earlier failures until stream reopen. Capture-window deltas do not reveal pre-window latch state;194 is stats.overruns, not that latch.
recovery_source_review.limits: Source review does not prove returned data correctness in the observed hardware run or establish the black-video cause.

lodoss.legacy_control_owner_result: Current C29 Legacy (Y) also produces black video with sound playing.

next_control: Both reader controls now failed at the same points. Build a bottom-reservation candidate that preserves original top-down allocation addresses; keep the complete New reader/cache and A2 profile.
